Cy Young Award Goes to Seoul Hurler
In 2027, the premier pitcher in the National League was <Dong-joo Moon:player#49880>. The <Seoul:team#403> starter is this year's recipient of the Cy Young Award.

He went 28-2 in 34 starts with 314 strikeouts in 240.2 innings and an impressive 2.36 ERA.

He received 20 first place votes out of a possible 32. <Tarik Skubal:player#26105> of the <Seoul Yukies:team#403> finished second in voting with 12 first place votes, while <Yuna Ah:player#143824> of the <Seoul Yukies:team#403> finished third.
